name: africa-ingenierie
description: Plateforme web Africa Ingenierie  -  Next.js (public) + Payload CMS (dashboard)

scripts.up:data: docker compose --env-file .env.local up -d postgres minio mailpit
scripts.reset:deps: docker compose --env-file .env.local down && docker volume rm -f africa-ingenierie_nm_root africa-ingenierie_nm_web africa-ingenierie_nm_cms africa-ingenierie_nm_ui africa-ingenierie_nm_validation
scripts.migrate: docker compose --env-file .env.local run --rm cms pnpm --filter @africa-ingenierie/cms migrate
scripts.migrate:create: docker compose --env-file .env.local run --rm cms pnpm --filter @africa-ingenierie/cms migrate:create
scripts.migrate:status: docker compose --env-file .env.local run --rm cms pnpm --filter @africa-ingenierie/cms migrate:status
scripts.db:reset: docker compose --env-file .env.local rm -sf postgres && docker volume rm -f africa-ingenierie_postgres_data && docker compose --env-file .env.local up -d postgres
scripts.bootstrap:users: docker compose --env-file .env.local run --rm cms pnpm --filter @africa-ingenierie/cms bootstrap:users
scripts.seed:demo: docker compose --env-file .env.local run --rm cms pnpm --filter @africa-ingenierie/cms seed:demo
scripts.db:clean-tests: docker compose --env-file .env.local run --rm cms pnpm --filter @africa-ingenierie/cms db:clean-tests
scripts.db:repair-audit: docker compose --env-file .env.local run --rm cms pnpm --filter @africa-ingenierie/cms db:repair-audit
scripts.generate:types: docker compose --env-file .env.local run --rm cms pnpm --filter @africa-ingenierie/cms generate:types
scripts.test: docker compose --env-file .env.local run --rm cms pnpm --filter @africa-ingenierie/cms test
scripts.test:e2e: docker compose --env-file .env.local run --rm cms pnpm --filter @africa-ingenierie/cms test:e2e
